_comment: Deployment configuration — externalizes what used to be hardcoded in backend/pipeline_worker.py and backend/main.py, closing PS #1 objective 12 (updated PDF): 'adaptable and configurable for deployment across multiple educational environments.' Deploying to a new room means editing this file, not the codebase. image_points/seats are pixel coordinates from calibration/calibrate_tool.py; plane_points are the corresponding real-world/desk-plane coordinates from the same calibration session.

cameras._comment: SIMULATED second camera for demonstrating occlusion fusion — this project has only one real camera's footage. Reuses the same video through a different homography purely to exercise the fusion code path with real pose data. Real multi-camera deployment needs genuine second-camera hardware calibrated with calibration/calibrate_tool.py against its own footage.

SIMULATED — Hall B has no real second camera either; this reuses the same single video source this whole project has (data/test_videos/04) through yet another homography, purely to give the multi-hall navigation shell (Phase 1) and analyst wall (Phase 2) real multiple halls to scope and group by. Deliberately reuses the same proven image_points region as cam04_illustrative (known to have real tracked people in this footage) rather than an unverified guess elsewhere in frame, which produced zero tracked seats when tried. Not a second physical room.
